description: Defines the LowLevelAlloc class for thread-safe low-level memory allocation, including methods for allocating and freeing memory, managing arenas, and platform-specific configurations.

classes.name: LowLevelAlloc
classes.description: A thread-safe memory allocator class providing static methods for memory management and arena handling.

methods.name: Alloc
methods.description: Allocates a block of memory of at least 'request' bytes from the default arena.

methods.name: AllocWithArena
methods.description: Allocates memory of at least 'request' bytes from a specified arena.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Deallocates a previously allocated memory block.

methods.name: NewArena
methods.description: Creates a new memory arena with specified flags.

methods.name: DeleteArena
methods.description: Destroys a specified arena if no allocated blocks remain.
